name: Fabric warehouse snapshots
short_description: Warehouse snapshots in Microsoft Fabric provide a read-only, transactionally consistent view of a warehouse as of a point in time and can be rolled forward on demand while consumers keep the same connection.

evidence.quote: Fabric warehouse snapshots lock a point in time, transactionally consistent, read only, zero copy.
A fabric warehouse snapshot is read only, point in time, and transactionally consistent.
